text.en: An antagonist is simply a drug with the 'opposite' effect of an agonist, like a drug that lowers blood pressure being an antagonist to one that raises it -- in reality, agonist and antagonist are defined relative to a specific receptor, not to a physiological outcome: an antagonist binds the same receptor as its paired agonist and blocks it without activating it, it doesn't need to produce any opposite effect of its own.
text.et: Antagonist on lihtsalt ravim, millel on agonisti 'vastupidine' toime, näiteks vererõhku langetav ravim on antagonist vererõhku tõstvale ravimile -- tegelikult defineeritakse agonist ja antagonist konkreetse retseptori, mitte füsioloogilise tulemuse suhtes: antagonist seondub sama retseptoriga, mis tema paariline agonist, ja blokeerib selle ilma seda aktiveerimata, ning ei pea ise tekitama mingit vastupidist toimet.
